codeforge.ai.enabled.description: Enable the CodeForge AI Agent. When disabled, the Agent sidebar will not run tasks.

codeforge.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Mirror of the **active** server in [CodeForge Settings](command:codeforge.openSettings). Manage multiple providers there — this value is overwritten on save.
codeforge.ai.provider.deprecationMessage: Use CodeForge Settings (Models → Add Server) to manage providers. This setting only mirrors the active server.

codeforge.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription: Mirror of the active server API key. Edit keys in [CodeForge Settings](command:codeforge.openSettings).
codeforge.ai.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Use CodeForge Settings to manage API keys per server. This setting only mirrors the active server.

codeforge.ai.model.markdownDescription: Mirror of the active model. Pick models in [CodeForge Settings](command:codeforge.openSettings).
codeforge.ai.model.deprecationMessage: Use CodeForge Settings to manage models per server. This setting only mirrors the active model.

codeforge.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Mirror of the active server base URL. Edit URLs in [CodeForge Settings](command:codeforge.openSettings).
codeforge.ai.baseUrl.deprecationMessage: Use CodeForge Settings to manage base URLs per server. This setting only mirrors the active server.

codeforge.ai.mode.description: Default AI interaction mode (Ask = answers only, Plan = explore + wiki plan, Agent = tools with approvals). Use the Allow all permission chip for session auto-approve.

codeforge.ai.weakModelMode.markdownDescription: Small-model harness: **on** = phase tool filtering + tighter guardrails; **off** = full tool surface (default). Legacy values: `force`→on, `auto`→off. Per-model knobs: [CodeForge Settings → Benchmark](command:codeforge.openSettings?%5B%22benchmark%22%5D).

codeforge.ai.collapseToolCards.description: Collapse completed tool cards in the Agent chat, keeping only running tools expanded

codeforge.ai.autoApproveEdits.description: Automatically apply all file edits (write/rename/delete) without asking

codeforge.ai.allowAll.description: Auto-approve every agent tool without prompts (global). Same as the chat Allow all chip.

codeforge.ai.confirmRunPython.description: Show a confirmation dialog before running Python snippets from the chat Run button

codeforge.ai.outboundMcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Expose project wiki tools on loopback HTTP for external MCP clients. Off by default. When enabled, CodeForge stores a bearer token in SecretStorage; clients must send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

codeforge.ai.outsideWorkspaceWrites.description: Policy for write/edit/delete/rename/apply_patch targeting paths outside the workspace folder

codeforge.ai.previewEdits.description: Show DiffPreview before writing existing files (off by default)

codeforge.ai.protectExistingTests.description: Test files that existed before the turn are the spec: the agent may add tests to them and follow its own renames, but does not change or remove existing assertions and does not delete the files. Turn off when you want the agent to rewrite existing tests.

codeforge.ai.shellSandbox.markdownDescription: Shell sandbox for agent commands (the model cannot override this). **restricted** (default): scrub secret env vars and block dangerous patterns (rm -rf, PowerShell download cradles, …). **safe-local**: allowlist of read/build commands only. **isolated** (Windows): Job Object with kill-on-close — fails visibly if unavailable (no silent downgrade). **container**: Docker with `--network=none`. **unrestricted**: full env + no blocked patterns (still workspace cwd). Overridden by **Full agent freedom**. There is no egress firewall outside container/`web_fetch` SSRF checks.

codeforge.ai.fullAgentFreedom.markdownDescription: Maximum autonomy: unrestricted shell sandbox, **Allow all** (`codeforge.ai.allowAll`), auto-approve file edits, and session shell auto-approve. Use only on trusted machines and workspaces.

codeforge.ai.agentCheckpointSteps.description: Checkpoint every N steps: evaluate agent progress and extend budget on positive reviews

codeforge.ai.agentHardCap.description: Max steps per agent task (absolute hard cap; uses your settings value as-is)

codeforge.ai.contextBudget.description: Fallback context window (tokens) when the active server has no num_ctx. Prefer setting num_ctx per server in CodeForge AI Settings.

codeforge.ai.semanticIndex.description: Build and refresh the code index (lexical + embeddings when the provider supports /embeddings). auto = on activation and on file changes; off = metadata index only.

codeforge.ai.retrieveRerank.description: Rerank retrieve candidates with a short LLM call before they enter the context packet.

codeforge.ai.exploreSubagent.description: Allow delegating broad exploration questions to a read-only explore subagent (delegate_task mode=explore). Start-of-run retrieve + family stalls still cover focused lookups.

codeforge.ai.toolGroups.description: Named tool groups merged on top of CORE (all built-in groups are already CORE; this setting is redundant unless a mode lists extra names). Empty still includes CORE. MCP stays separate (mcp_call when servers are connected).

codeforge.ai.openModels.markdownDescription: Manage API/local servers and models in **[CodeForge Settings → Models](command:codeforge.openSettings?%5B%22models%22%5D)** (Add Server, keys, fetch models). Same UI as the CodeForge Settings panel.

codeforge.ai.openMcp.markdownDescription: Manage MCP servers in **[CodeForge Settings → MCP](command:codeforge.openSettings?%5B%22mcp%22%5D)**. Same UI as the CodeForge Settings panel.

codeforge.ai.openGuardrails.markdownDescription: Manage Skills, Rules, Policies and Guardrails in **[CodeForge Settings → Guardrails](command:codeforge.openSettings?%5B%22guardrails%22%5D)**. Same UI as the CodeForge Settings panel.

codeforge.update.checkOnStartup.description: Check GitHub for a newer release a few seconds after startup and offer a download link when one is available.

codeforge.update.githubRepo.description: GitHub owner/repo used for releases/latest (e.g. Kortexio/CodeForge). Leave empty to derive from the app name.

codeforge.update.apiBaseUrl.description: GitHub API base URL. Change for GitHub Enterprise or a mirror. Path used: {apiBaseUrl}/repos/{githubRepo}/releases/latest

codeforge.update.downloadUrl.description: Optional override URL for the Download button (internal page, CDN, SharePoint). When empty, opens the release page or Windows .exe asset.

codeforge.update.currentVersion.description: Optional local version override for update comparison. When empty, uses the codeforge extension package version.

walkthroughs.title: Set up CodeForge AI
walkthroughs.description: Add a server, pick a model, and start building with Agent

steps.title: Open AI Settings
steps.description:
CodeForge uses your own models — OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

[Open AI Settings](command:codeforge.openSettings)

steps.title: Add a server
steps.description:
In **Models**, click **Add server**, enter your API key or local base URL, then **Fetch models**.

[Open AI Settings](command:codeforge.openSettings)

steps.title: Pick your model
steps.description:
Use the model chip in the AI panel to switch models while you work.

[Switch model](command:codeforge.switchModel)

steps.title: Open the AI Agent
steps.description:
The Agent lives in the right sidebar. Ask questions, plan changes, and edit across your workspace.

[Focus AI Agent](command:codeforge.focusChat)
